description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and ever y where in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.    

 People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.   

 Attain Partners is seeking an experienced Migration & Integration Developer to support data migration and integration initiatives for Higher Education clients, with a strong emphasis on Advancement and fundraising systems. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and executing SQL-based data migrations and integrations between legacy Advancement platforms, institutional databases, and Salesforce environments. The ideal candidate has deep SQL development expertise, hands-on Salesforce configuration experience, and a strong understanding of Higher Education Advancement data, business processes, and system architecture. All migration and integration development will be performed primarily using SQL and database-native technologies, rather than integration platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi. Candidates must be comfortable building and maintaining data pipelines, transformation logic, staging tables, stored procedures, and integration processes directly within database environments. The developer will collaborate with technical architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and successful delivery of migration and integration solutions. 

 Required Skills 

 
 Advanced SQL Development: Strong hands-on experience writing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, joins, transformations, and data validation scripts. 

 Higher Education Experience: Previous experience working with colleges, universities, or university foundations on enterprise data initiatives. 

 Advancement Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of fundraising, donor management, gift processing, alumni relations, constituent management, and Advancement business processes. 

 Salesforce Configuration: Hands-on experience navigating and configuring Salesforce, including standard and custom objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, flows, and data models. 

 SQL-Based Data Migration: Experience developing extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes using SQL, including staging tables, source-to-target mappings, data transformations, reconciliation, and incremental data loads. 

 SQL-Based Data Integration: Experience building and supporting database-driven integrations, including scheduled data exchanges, incremental updates, error handling, and monitoring. 

 Data Mapping & Transformation: Ability to interpret source-to-target mapping specifications and translate business requirements into executable SQL transformation logic. 

 Data Quality & Validation: Experience developing reconciliation queries, duplicate identification logic, record-count validation, and exception reporting. 

 Database Expertise: Strong working knowledge of relational database technologies, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL. 

 Troubleshooting: Ability to independently diagnose and resolve data, SQL performance, transformation, and integration issues. 

 Client Collaboration: Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with client technical and functional teams. 

 
 Desired Skills 

 
 Experience with Higher Education Advancement platforms, such as Ellucian Advance, Kindsight ascend, Blackbaud CRM/Raiser's Edge, Banner Advancement, or Salesforce Education Cloud. 

 Familiarity with Advancement data structures, including constituents, households, relationships, gifts, pledges, payments, designations, campaigns, and recognition credits. 

 Experience migrating legacy Advancement platforms to Salesforce or Kindsight ascend. 

 Experience with Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API, and Salesforce data import/export processes. 

 Experience with Salesforce SOQL and Salesforce object relationships. 

 Experience with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Agent, or equivalent database scheduling technologies. 

 Experience developing reusable SQL scripts, data migration frameworks, and automated validation processes. 

 Understanding of data governance, data stewardship, data quality, and master data management principles. 

 Experience supporting mock migrations, user acceptance testing (UAT), cutover, and production deployments. 

 Familiarity with Git or other source control solutions for managing SQL development. 

 
 Years of Experience 

 
 5+ years of professional experience in SQL development, database development, data migration, or data integration.  

 3+ years of experience supporting Higher Education institutions, preferably within Advancement, fundraising, or alumni relations. 

 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including data model configuration, data loading, and troubleshooting. 

 Demonstrated experience completing at least one enterprise data migration or integration initiative involving a Higher Education Advancement system. 

 
 Certifications (Preferred but not required) 

 
 Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate 

 Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator 

 Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder 

 Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant 

 Oracle Database SQL Certified Associate or equivalent database certification 

 
 Additional Requirements 

 
 Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients 

 Experience supporting sales and business development 

 Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs 

 
 
 Additional Information 

 Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as: 

 
 Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs 

 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO) 

 Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting 

 Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us 

 A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you. 

 
  
 Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

 Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications. 

 Salary Range
 $120,000 — $130,000 USD 


  

  

 Attain Partners is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.   

 Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws. For more Information visit  EEO ,  EEO Poster Supplement ,  Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) , and  Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) .   

 If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for an accommodation or an alternative application process.
